engine.title: Four things a form cannot do
engine.sub: No adjectives — these are the steps every job goes through, with no one phoning you.

items.title: Reads your drawing or BOQ
items.body: Attach a drawing, a BOQ or a photo with your brief; the quantities and scope go into the request suppliers price.

items.title: Strips your identity
items.body: Your name, number and company are removed from the brief and from the drawings before any supplier sees them.

items.title: Invites only licensed suppliers
items.body: Only suppliers licensed for that trade in your emirate are invited — and the list is capped, so it never becomes a bidding flood.

items.title: Rejects incomplete quotes
items.body: A quote missing its price, lead time, validity or warranty goes back to the supplier before it ever reaches you.

supplierLanding.stepsTitle: From registration to your first quote

steps.title: Register your company
steps.body: Company name, emirate and trade, then a verified mobile and email.

steps.title: Get verified
steps.body: Upload a current trade licence and company profile and accept the supplier terms. Verification takes up to 3 working days.

steps.title: Confirm your scope
steps.body: Confirm the trades and emirates you actually cover. That scope decides which briefs reach you.

steps.title: Quote from the portal
steps.body: Every quote is checked for price, lead time, validity and warranty before the customer sees it.

supplierLanding.ruleBody: When a customer pays to reveal you, reply within 5 working days — we remind you after 3. If you stay silent, the customer is refunded in full and you owe the refunded fee plus an AED 250 administrative fee and 9% annual interest, and new matches pause until it is settled.
supplierLanding.honest: QuotesDone is new. There are no completed jobs on the platform yet, so nothing here promises you a pipeline — only that when work arrives, it is matched on fit.
supplierLanding.finalSub: Registration takes a few minutes. Have your trade licence and company profile to hand.

howPage.metaTitle: How QuotesDone works — anonymous quotes, end to end
howPage.metaDesc: How a construction, fit-out or MEP job moves through QuotesDone: the brief, licensed matching, checked quotes, the top-3 comparison and the reveal.
howPage.title: How an anonymous quote works, end to end
howPage.sub: Built for construction, fit-out and MEP — and it handles home-maintenance jobs too. Every step below is what the platform does, not what a person does for you.

steps.title: You describe the job
steps.body: Text, a photo, a drawing or a BOQ. No calls and no site-visit booking.

steps.title: The engine qualifies it
steps.body: It recognises the trade, asks the questions suppliers need answered and lists the documents and approvals they will be held to.

steps.title: Licensed suppliers are invited
steps.body: Only suppliers licensed for that trade in your emirate, capped so the job never becomes a bidding flood. Your identity is removed first.

steps.title: Quotes are checked
steps.body: A quote without a price, lead time, validity or warranty goes back to the supplier before you see it.

steps.title: You compare the top 3
steps.body: Levelled on price, completeness and delivery, side by side. Export the comparison as a PDF.

steps.title: You reveal one — or none
steps.body: Pay 3% of the quote you choose, nothing else. Only that supplier learns who you are.

howPage.maskSub: Anonymity runs both ways until you reveal, and the other bidders are never revealed at all.
